To accept incoming peers, forward port 18080 of your router to the phone’s IP. On mobile networks (CGNAT) this is usually impossible; the node still works with outgoing peers only.

Allow EasynodeDroid to install apps (switch on the screen that opens), then come back and tap “Install the update” again.

While the node runs: downloads, checks the signature, stops the node, installs and restarts it. Android may ask for one confirmation. Never on mobile data unless allowed above.
To star: tap “Star” at the top of the page.
